samir: Heads-up  Private Deploy 2.7 GA planned for 2026-06-10. This release adds two customer-facing features for on-prem/VPC: (1) BYO-HSM integration for tenant key wrapping, (2) SBOM-based supply-chain attestations for our on-prem agent. Short bullets:
- BYO-HSM: customers can register an on-prem HSM (PKCS#11 or cloud HSM gateway) to wrap tenant-level master keys. We provide a small connector and verification flow.
- SBOM attestations: agent packages include signed SBOMs (SPDX v2.3) and a verification tool to generate attest bundles for auditors.
- Selective telemetry scrub: customers can opt to strip command args and filenames from rotation/agent telemetry before export.

Impact & compatibility:
- No forced churn. Existing key flows continue for 60 days after GA; customers can opt-in to BYO-HSM anytime.
- Air-gapped installs: BYO-HSM works locally; SBOM bundles are generated locally and signed.

Quick actions:
- SEs: identify top BYO-HSM candidates and flag for early validation (zoe).
- Docs: BYO-HSM setup guide + SBOM verification steps (lucy).
- Security: review connector threat model and key lifecycle (sec-bot).
- Ops: schedule partner canary and patch window (ops-bot).

Example CLI snippets:
```
# register HSM gateway
rwctl hsm register --tenant TID --endpoint https://hsm.local --type pkcs11 --cert hsm-cert.pem
# produce signed SBOM bundle
rwctl agent sbom export --agent-id AGENT123 --out sbom-bundle.tar.gz
```
